key_claims.claim: TRICERATOPS validation thresholds are FPP < 0.015 and NFPP < 1e-3 (likely planet: FPP < 0.5 & NFPP < 1e-3; likely nearby FP: NFPP > 0.1); FPP = 1 - (P_TP + P_PTP + P_DTP) and NFPP sums only the nearby-star scenarios, so NFPP is 0 whenever no resolved neighbours are passed in.
key_claims.source: Giacalone et al. 2021 arXiv:2002.00691 abstract; triceratops/triceratops.py source (FPP/NFPP computation) read 2026-10-17
key_claims.how_checked: WebFetch of arXiv abstract and of the raw triceratops.py source; matches Kuber's NFPP=0 caveat in planethunt SCIENCE.md

key_claims.claim: DR25 Robovetter thresholds: LPP > 2.2 (DV) / 3.2 (ALT); model-shift MS1 > 1.0, MS2 > 2.0, MS3 > 4.0 (DV) or MS1 > -3, MS2 > 1, MS3 > 1 (ALT); Rubble < 0.75; Chases median < 0.8; Marshall BIC >= 10; SES_max/MES > 0.8 for P > 90 d; odd/even sigma_OE > 1.1; V-shape Rp/R* + b > 1.04; secondary MS4 > 1, MS5 > 0, MS6 > 0 with planet-occultation exception (albedo < 1, Rp < 30 Re, secondary < 10 % of primary, b < 0.95); centroid FP if 3-sigma offset > 2 arcsec or 4-sigma offset > 1 arcsec (unresolved) or brightest pixel > 1.5 px from target in >= 2/3 of quarters (resolved).
key_claims.source: Thompson et al. 2018 arXiv:1710.06758 Appendix A (HTML offsets 100k-300k and PDF text)
key_claims.how_checked: Multiple WebFetch passes over the arXiv HTML plus pdftotext of the arXiv PDF

key_claims.source: arXiv:1401.1240 HTML; Thompson 2018 Appendix A.6 (PDF text)

actionable_steps: Create an isolated vetting venv (uv venv venv-vet --python 3.13; uv pip install triceratops leo-vetter exovetter lightkurve spiceypy 'git+https://github.com/stevepur/transit-diffImage') so TRICERATOPS' pytransit==2.2 / setuptools<81 pins never touch the search venv; verify imports of triceratops, leo_vetter.main, leo_vetter.pixel, exovetter.vetters.

Write PREREG.md before opening any light curve: frozen target list hash, detrending method and windows, search band, number of peaks, first-screen thresholds, hold-out rule (last max(2, ceil(0.25 N)) quarters/sectors), inverted (f -> 2-f) and scrambled control runs through the full pipeline including triage, injection-recovery subsample, stopping rule; git-tag it.

Implement the Stage 1-9 checklist from the brief as an automated per-candidate runner that appends JSON records (test, inputs, statistic, threshold, pass/fail/inconclusive, code hash, timestamp) to vetting/<candidate>/decision_log.jsonl and never edits thresholds after the first candidate.
Run LEO-Vetter flux-level vetting (scripts/leo_flux_vet.py pattern) on every first-screen survivor, on its inverted copy, and at P/2 and 2P; log all 121 metrics; treat any FA/FP flag as a hard stop.

Run scripts/novelty_check.py (box-query TAP with legacy fallback, ExoFOP TOI+CTOI CSVs, Villanova CSRF POST, VizieR J/AJ/151/68 and J/ApJS/258/16, local Kostov 2025 tables, Gaia vari/NSS, SIMBAD) and compute Coughlin 2014 sigma_P/sigma_T for period ratios up to 50:1 against every object within >= 10 arcmin and everything on the same CCD channel/column (Kepler-RaDex2Pix or TPF headers); record the query date in the report.

For KBONUS candidates implement Kuber's three which-star-dims tests: neighbour PSF light curves at the ephemeris, per-quarter SAP depth vs FLFRCSAP x PSF/SAP dilution model, raw-TPF flux-weighted centroid shifts vs the first-order prediction for each Gaia source within 30 arcsec; ignore the KBONUS CENTROID_COLUMN/ROW columns.

For TESS candidates run transit-diffImage + LEO pixel vetting per sector, require offset <= 15 arcsec with prfFitQuality >= 0.3 in >= 2 sectors, add a sign-aware control (the inverted light curve must not localise) and an F-test against every neighbour that could produce the depth.

Run TRICERATOPS 1.1.0 >= 10 times per candidate with one cadence per run, real neighbours within 10 px (calc_depths), a Gaia-based field population (never rely on TRILEGAL in Oct 2026), dilution_corrected set correctly for the flux type, any ExoFOP contrast curves (download_filelist.php / download_files.php) and a MOLUSC kept.csv built with --gaia --ruwe; report mean +/- spread of FPP and NFPP, the dominant scenario, and any skipped scenarios.

Produce the survey-level honesty tables automatically: stars searched vs selected, every first-screen pass in real and inverted runs, scrambled-run passes, injection-recovery completeness, false-alarm fraction vs SNR from the inverted sample, and the failing test for every rejected signal.

Before any public statement, re-check KOI/TCE/TOI/CTOI/EB tables on release day, propagate the ephemeris uncertainty to the next observable transits, publish code + data hashes + decision log with a Zenodo DOI, and use only the words 'planet candidate' with an explicit FPP unless FPP < 0.015 and NFPP < 1e-3 with imaging and spectroscopy in hand and a refereed paper accepted.

Plan the publication route around ExoFOP's 2026-08-19 rule: a peer-reviewed paper (AJ/MNRAS candidates paper, or RNAAS only if the methods were already published) is now a prerequisite for ExoFOP ingestion of a community candidate.
